Thank you — I've reviewed page 2 of the OIML Certificate. Here's a summary of its contents:

## Certificate Details
- **Certificate Number:** R76/2006-A-NL1-21.15
- **Project Number:** 2561497
- **OIML Member State:** The Netherlands (NMi)
- **Supporting Type Evaluation Report:** No. NMi-2561497-01, dated 4 May 2021 (53 pages)

## Characteristics of the Indicator

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Accuracy class | (III) or (IIII) |
| Weighing ranges | Single interval / Multi-interval |
| Max. scale intervals (one weighing range) | n ≤ 6000 |
| Max. scale intervals (multi-interval) | n ≤ 3000 per partial weighing range |
| Max. number of (partial) weighing ranges | 2 |
| Load cell excitation voltage | 3 V DC |
| Minimum signal input voltage | U_min = 0 mV |
| Min. input voltage per verification scale interval | 0.45 µV |
| Minimum load cell resistance | 87 Ω |
| Maximum load cell resistance | 1200 Ω |
| Fraction of the maximum permissible error | 0.5 |
| Load cell connection | 6-wire (with sense technology), may be configured as 4-wire |
| Max. cable length per cross wire section | 2589 m/mm² (if sense technology is not used, load cells connect directly without junction box) |
| Temperature range | 0 °C to +40 °C |
| Power supply | 100–240 V AC 50/60 Hz (AC/DC plug-in power supply) or 3.6 V DC battery |
| Software identification | Version V2.xx (xx = 01…99) |

## Software Note
- The identification number is displayed after pressing the (i) key on the display.

This page specifies the technical and metrological limits within which the indicator is approved. Is there anything specific you'd like to know — for example, interpretation of a parameter, or how this relates to page 1?
